10 Points = 4 miles Rewards to Miles Conversion for Selected Airline Partners
Conversion Fee Waived for each conversion of points to frequent flyer miles
Earn 10X TREATS Points (equivalent to 4 air miles) at selected retail, dining merchants and petrol stations

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Annual Interest Rate: 27.90% p.a. subject to a minimum charge of S$3.00
annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Fee Waiver: Waiver for first Year. Subsequent annual fee will be automatically waived with a total minimum spend of S$24,000 per annum
annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Minimum Monthly Repayment: 3% of outstanding balance or S$20, whichever is higher

our_takes.our-take: The Maybank World Mastercard rewards overseas spending (up to 2.8 miles per dollar), but only for big spenders who can hit the minimum spend of $800 or $4,000. The 10X TREATS Points (4mpd) at selected merchants can be valuable if they align with your spending habits. Otherwise, local spending earns a low 0.4 miles per dollar. While the first year fee is waived, the subsequent $261.60 annual fee is waived only with a hefty $24,000 annual spend. Consider if the lounge access and golf benefits justify the high spending requirements.
our_takes.good-for:
Affluent individuals seeking premium rewards and exclusive lifestyle benefits like golf club access and airport lounge privileges.
Professionals who frequently travel overseas and spend a minimum of $800 to maximize TREATS Points.
High-income earners with substantial retail spending habits looking to earn accelerated rewards at selected merchants.
our_takes.things-to-note:
A 2.25% admin fee and 1% currency conversion fee apply to foreign transactions, increasing overseas spending costs.
Late payment fees are high: 5% of the minimum repayment or $100, whichever is higher, if unpaid by the due date.
Interest is high at 27.90% p.a., charged if you don't pay in full each month, subject to a $3 minimum.
